reviews.text: The Ultimate Spot Cream is the only spot cream that I like, much better compared to Benton goodbye redness and Some by mi all kill miracle spot cream. I feel like the zinc oxide is the powerhouse ingredient, while the aloe and sunflower seed oil are the soothing and skin balancing ingredients. I also like that there is a generous amount in the tube that will last forever. I don't have many spots, but when they come this will help.
reviews.zh: The Ultimate Spot Cream 係我唯一鍾意嘅局部暗瘡膏，比 Benton goodbye redness 同 Some By Mi All Kill Miracle Spot Cream 都好好多。我覺得氧化鋅係最有力嘅成分，而蘆薈同葵花籽油就係舒緩同平衡皮膚嘅成分。我亦鍾意條管裝嘅份量好多，可以用好耐。我冇乜暗瘡，但係一長痘嗰時，呢款就會幫到我。

reviews.text: It actually works and gets rid of pimples. It doesn’t get rid of all, it depends on the type of pimple but it gets rid of most. I like that it’s not so dehydrating and I can put it all over my face, use moisturiser and it’s still fine. I use it to prevent pimples too, on days when I eat too much junk food and think a pimple might come tomorrow. One of the best pimple products I’ve tried. Definitely recommend people to try it
reviews.zh: 佢真係有效，可以消除粒痘。唔係全部都可以消除，要視乎粒痘嘅種類，但係大部分都可以。我鍾意佢唔會太乾，我可以成面塗，然後再擦保濕霜，都仍然冇問題。我亦會用嚟預防長痘，例如係食咗太多垃圾食物、覺得聽日可能會長粒痘嗰日子。係我用過最好嘅粒痘產品之一。非常推薦大家試吓。

reviews.text:
This one has the creamiest consistency out of the spot treatments I've tried, surprisingly it blends and just melts in the skin so I can use it still during the daytime, I apply this before moisturizer and it doesn't pill. This has an airy-mousse texture that doesn't feel heavy on the skin. Works well alone but better after using the patch from the same line. At night though, as the last step of my routine, I like to dab and leave on a thicker layer, it shrinks and help dry out my acne (but not my skin). I like the faint tea tree scent it has and I find that the packaging is easy to control, it dispenses the right amount, you only need to use a small amount ??applying to much can leave a white cast and makes it harder to blend. 
Versus other spot treatments: this doesn't feel like anything during application
reviews.zh:
呢款係我試過嘅局部暗瘡產品當中最幼滑嘅一款，出奇地可以融入皮膚，所以我日間都仍然可以用。我塗咗之後再搽保濕霜，佢唔會起搓。佢質地好似空氣慕絲咁，唔會令皮膚覺得厚重。單獨用都好好，但係如果配合同一系列嘅貼片一齊用就更好。夜晚嗰時，我會塗一層厚啲，當係護膚步驟最後一步，佢會令暗瘡縮細，幫手乾身（但唔會令皮膚乾）。我鍾意佢淡淡嘅茶樹味，亦覺得包裝容易控制，每次都可以擠出啱啱好嘅份量，你只需要用少量——塗多咗會留白，亦都令到更難推開。
與其他局部暗瘡產品比較：呢款喺塗嗰時完全冇感覺。

reviews.text: I've been using it every night after my cleanser and toner and moisturizer. I'm quite puzzled which type of serum to use or should I use one before applying this. Bc I think, by its consistency, it will be hard for it to penetrate to the skin if other steps of skincare are involved in between. So I used this alone in my routine like cleanser - toner - thin application of moisturizer - aha/bha. Only thin moisturizer just to overdo the dryness the exfoliation could make. Then in the morning, I rub softly to physically exfoliate. There's no instruction like this to be done, but I'm just doing it instead of just washing away what's on top of the skin. Physical exfoliating might help more to let it penetrate the skin.
reviews.zh: 我每晚都喺潔面、爽膚水同保濕霜之後用呢款，但係我好疑惑應該用邊類精華，或者應唔應該喺佢之前用精華。我諗佢嘅質地咁厚，喺其他步驟之間，應該好難滲入皮膚。所以我單獨用呢款，順序係：潔面 - 爽膚水 - 薄薄一層保濕霜 - AHA/BHA。我加一層薄保濕霜，只係為咗防止去角質之後過度乾燥。然後早上，我會輕輕揉搓，做物理去角質。雖然冇指示咁做，但我就咁做，而唔係只係沖走皮膚表面嘅嘢。物理去角質可能令佢更加滲入皮膚。

reviews.text: With any spot treatment make sure you take the needed amount you need and rub the affected area, then you put a little bit more on the blemish in a patting motion. With this method, this stopped numerous zits on my nose. You know those suckers, once they sprout they stay there for a good week, then leaves a nasty scar that wont even cover with pot concealer. But with this spot treatment, it disappears overnight. TRY TO CATCH THE ZIT IN THE EARLY STAGE. ITS THE MOST EFFECTIVE TO USE DURING THAT MOMENT.
reviews.zh: 用任何局部暗瘡產品，都要攞需要嘅份量，揉喺受影響嘅位置，然後再多少少，用拍打嘅動作塗喺粒痘上面。用呢個方法，我鼻頭嗰啲多粒痘都停咗。你知嗰啲煩人嘅東西，一旦冒出嚟就會留足成個星期，之後留低一道難睇嘅疤痕，連罐裝遮瑕膏都遮唔住。但係用呢款局部產品，就會一夜間消失。要盡量喺早期就捉住粒痘。喺嗰個時候用，效果最好。

reviews.text:
I absolutely LOVE this cream. I suffer from acne prone skin and literally within a day of putting this on, I saw acne from a breakout practically disappear. I've been using it every day since then and it is very soothing for skin. I haven't had any breakouts since, and I've noticed that acne scarring is greatly reduced when this cream is applied. 

The only thing that I would mention is that cream will continue to come out of the tube if the cap isn't put back on immediately. Thats a design issue and I hope the packaging for this product will be updated.
reviews.zh:
我真係好愛呢款面霜。我易生暗瘡，而且塗咗之後，一日之內，爆咗嘅暗瘡幾乎完全消失。由嗰時開始，我每日都用，對皮膚好舒緩。之後一粒痘都冇再長，而且我留意到，塗咗呢款之後，暗瘡疤痕都大大減少。

我唯一想提嘅係，如果唔即刻將蓋蓋返，霜會繼續由條管入面擠出嚟。呢個係設計問題，我希望呢款產品嘅包裝可以改善。

reviews.text:
If you are like me and have those extremely painful monster of pimples which stay under the skin for days before forming a mountain of red on your face, then you will love this.
Apply it the moment u see something forming under the skin and watch how this cream kills/reduces the infection so much and your misery is vastly reduced.
Not as effective on pimples that have already "ripened" or got the white heads...for those please use the pimple patches. But for your about to firm, painful angry ones, this is the bomb.
reviews.zh:
如果你同我一樣，常常有啲極之痛、好似大山咁嘅粒痘，埋喺皮膚底下幾日，然後喺面上長成一大片紅，咁你一定會鍾意呢款。
一見到皮膚底下開始成粒，就塗呢款，睇吓佢點樣殺死／減低感染，痛苦會大大減低。
對於已經「熟透」或者有白頭嘅痘痘，效果就唔係咁好，嗰啲就請用痘痘貼。但係對於即將發炎、好痛、紅腫嘅痘痘，呢款絕對係神器。

reviews.text: If you have acne, buy this product immediately. I have cystic, scabby acne and combination skin. I applied a thick spot of this cream over each blemish and left it on all day (and all night - I just didn’t was my face that evening to leave the cream on) and I’m not even exaggerating all my acne has gone. poof. vanished. now I just have acne scars to handle! I used this with the mild ac toner as well. I would buy them both if you have acne like me, it’s a miracle product!
reviews.zh: 如果你有暗瘡，立即買呢款產品。我有囊腫性、結痂嘅暗瘡，同埋混合性皮膚。我喺每粒痘上面塗咗厚厚一層呢款面霜，然後成日都唔除走（成晚都留住，我嗰晚冇洗面，就係要留住面霜），我冇誇張，我嘅暗瘡全部都冇咗。啪一聲，消失咗。而家我只係要處理暗瘡疤痕！我仲同 mild ac 化妝水一齊用。如果你好似我咁有暗瘡，我會兩樣一齊買，佢係奇蹟產品！
